title: Product Quality and Performance in the Internet Age: Evidence from Creationist-Friendly Curriculum
eligible_reason: Single policy date (2008 Louisiana Science Education Act), Louisiana schools vs Texas schools. Two-group, pre/post design with one adoption cohort. Main columns also include district-level socioeconomic controls and controls x After.
design_notes: JMR 59(1), 2022. Table 2 (baseline): treatment = Louisiana_i x After_t (After = year >= 2008), unit = school, year FE and school FE, SEs clustered by school district. Columns 1-3 lack school FE; Columns 4-7 have school and year FE but also controls (X_dt district socioeconomic, Z_d x After_t). Column 4: coef .162 (SE .0616), N=12,077; Column 5: .171 (.075), N=10,124 (needs internet data); Column 6 (levels): .152 (.043), N=11,338; Column 7 (science total): .0017 (.0004). Figure 2 is a Louisiana-vs-Texas event study around the one date. Tables 7-8 use Google Trends keyword-by-state(-or-city)-by-year panels with the same Louisiana x After design, and Table 9 is a respondent-level linear probability model. Tables 10-11 are robustness variants.
screener_notes: Not eligible. Single adoption date; no staggered cohorts. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.

ineligible_specs.reason: single adoption date (2008); also include district-level time-varying controls; no no-controls TWFE column (Column 2 has year FE only)
event study around the single 2008 date
